title: Clarify ambiguous teacher questions without assuming wrongdoing
summary: The teacher now distinguishes free or no-subscription access questions from explicit requests to bypass protections.

changes.detail: Added neutral intent clarification for ambiguous phrases such as without subscription, free channels and IPTV. Earlier assistant assumptions are not evidence of user intent; current service availability must not be invented.
